svg.text: MySQL Enterprise Studio • Sales_Quiz Database • Star Schema Dimensional Model & CTE Analytics

g.text: • 3rd Normal Form (3NF) core normalized to Star Schema for high-throughput OLAP analytics
• Foreign keys enforced with cascading references & indexed composite joins
ADVANCED ANALYTICAL SQL ENGINE • CTEs & WINDOW FUNCTIONS
DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.city ORDER BY SUM(p.price * s.quantity) DESC) AS city_rank
JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name, c.city, cat.category_name
RESULT GRID: 5 ROWS RETURNED • DURATION: 0.0082 SEC • FETCH: 0.0011 SEC
